lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three to four roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the most intense local maxima situated in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary blobs, forming an identifiable grid-like matrix across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible across the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast gradient with increased luminance on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or loss of tissue is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, lower-luminance spots that are notably smaller and more densely packed than the primary lateral blobs.
